scheme_name: Scheme Of Provision Of Subsidized Rams To Sheep Breeders
other_conditions: Must have a registered sheep unit
Must have a flock of at least 25 sheep
Maximum of two rams can be allotted to one beneficiary
Beneficiary must sign an agreement not to sell or castrate the allotted ram during its breeding life
benefits_summary: Provides sheep breeders with high‑quality rams at a 60% subsidy, enhancing wool productivity and profitability.
